rules.rule: Display traveler identity, dates, timezone, route/location, fare rules, taxes/fees, cancellation policy, baggage limits, inventory hold time, and final total beside every booking, reservation, change, or cancellation submit.
rules.rationale: Decision context must be visible at the moment of commitment.
rules.failureMode: Missing context causes calendar selects local date but itinerary uses destination timezone.

rules.rule: Show inventory hold timer in the same visual group as the primary action.
rules.rationale: The highest-risk identifier must travel with the action.
rules.failureMode: The user acts without seeing inventory hold timer.

rules.rule: Label data freshness or status whenever the view contains search results, comparison cards, checkout, itinerary, map/list views, and cancellation flows.
rules.rationale: Users must know whether operational data is current.
rules.failureMode: The interface hides stale context around search results, comparison cards, checkout, itinerary, map/list views, and cancellation flows.

rules.rule: Require a review step before booking submit, passenger name entry, fare purchase, cancellation, and document requirement confirmation.
rules.rationale: High-cost actions need an interruption for verification.
rules.failureMode: The user completes booking submit, passenger name entry, fare purchase, cancellation, and document requirement confirmation without review.

rules.rule: Block silent changes to critical values after review in booking, reservation, change, or cancellation submit.
rules.rationale: Consent depends on the reviewed values staying stable.
rules.failureMode: The UI allows calendar selects local date but itinerary uses destination timezone.

rules.rule: Provide a recovery or correction path when calendar selects local date but itinerary uses destination timezone.
rules.rationale: High-cost mistakes need visible next steps.
rules.failureMode: The user cannot recover after calendar selects local date but itinerary uses destination timezone.

rules.rule: Match density to search results, comparison cards, checkout, itinerary, map/list views, and cancellation flows; do not use decorative spacing that separates labels from values.
rules.rationale: Domain work depends on scanning related facts together.
rules.failureMode: Related labels and values drift apart visually.

rules.rule: Keep required identifiers visible at mobile widths for booking, reservation, change, or cancellation submit.
rules.rationale: Narrow screens are common at decision time.
rules.failureMode: Mobile layout hides inventory hold timer.

rules.rule: Do not use decorative motion around inventory expiration, price changes, map/list orientation, booking steps, or payment review.
rules.rationale: Motion must not hide or trivialize domain state.
rules.failureMode: Motion obscures calendar selects local date but itinerary uses destination timezone.

rules.rule: Provide a reduced-motion path for status changes involving inventory-expired, price-changed, timezone-difference, passport-id-required, split-booking, extra-payment-verification, cancellation-refund-status, and offline-itinerary.
rules.rationale: State meaning must survive user motion preferences.

rules.rule: Use exact labels for local time, destination time, fare rule, hold expires, nonrefundable, final total, baggage limit, amenity, and document name.
rules.rationale: Precise terms map to different user decisions.
rules.failureMode: A vague label masks calendar selects local date but itinerary uses destination timezone.

rules.rule: Do not use color alone to distinguish inventory-expired, price-changed, timezone-difference, passport-id-required, split-booking, extra-payment-verification, cancellation-refund-status, and offline-itinerary.
rules.rationale: Status must be perceivable without color vision.
rules.failureMode: Users miss a state among inventory-expired, price-changed, timezone-difference, passport-id-required, split-booking, extra-payment-verification, cancellation-refund-status, and offline-itinerary.

rules.rule: Provide states for inventory-expired, price-changed, timezone-difference, passport-id-required, split-booking, extra-payment-verification, cancellation-refund-status, and offline-itinerary.
rules.rationale: Domain flows contain more than loading/success/error.
rules.failureMode: A missing state causes calendar selects local date but itinerary uses destination timezone.

rules.rule: Use exact labels for local time, destination time, fare rule, hold expires, nonrefundable, final total, baggage limit, amenity, and document name.
rules.failureMode: A generic label causes calendar selects local date but itinerary uses destination timezone.

rules.rule: Define ambiguous values as selected, held, expired, unavailable, partially available, nonrefundable, local time, destination time, and final total.
rules.rationale: Users should not infer whether values are final or provisional.
rules.failureMode: A provisional value is treated as final in booking, reservation, change, or cancellation submit.

rules.rule: Provide states for inventory-expired, price-changed, timezone-difference, passport-id-required, split-booking, extra-payment-verification, cancellation-refund-status, and offline-itinerary.
rules.rationale: Domain flows contain more than loading/success/error.
rules.failureMode: A missing state causes calendar selects local date but itinerary uses destination timezone.

rules.rule: Preserve user input or task context when recovery is needed after booking, reservation, change, or cancellation submit.
rules.rationale: Recovery without preserved context still fails the task.
rules.failureMode: The user must restart after calendar selects local date but itinerary uses destination timezone.

rules.rule: Expose an empty or unavailable state that explains whether search results, comparison cards, checkout, itinerary, map/list views, and cancellation flows are absent, filtered, stale, or permission denied.
rules.rationale: Empty states need cause and next action.
rules.failureMode: Users cannot distinguish absent data from hidden data.

rules.rule: Keep inventory hold timer visible in confirmation and receipt states.
rules.rationale: Receipts are evidence and recovery anchors.
rules.failureMode: The confirmation omits inventory hold timer.
